content:
The options available depend whether the account is setup to use Imap for pop3/

Imap

You can move the deleted email from trash to any existing imap folder.

  1. Select the email within the trash folder.
  2. Press the three dot menu.
  3. Press Move.
  4. Select the desired folder.

Pop3

Moving an email from the trash folder is NOT supported. Sending the email back to yourself may be a workaround for a one off mail.

The feature addition has been suggested by the community on Mozilla connect. You can show your interest by up-voting the idea.

https://connect.mozilla.org/t5/ideas/thunderbird-android-undelete-move-from-trash/idi-p/103680

The below Github ticket is related to the same question. https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-android/issues/10922
